name: Handout 4: The Tribune's Sealed Orders
player_description:
SENATUS POPULUSQUE ROMANUS

By authority of the Senate and the consulship of Lucius Fulvius Rufus and Marcus Plautius Quintillus:

Tribune Lucius Valerius Maximus is hereby empowered to act in the Senate's name in all matters pertaining to the artifact recovered at Fort Vindolanda.

All military personnel are ordered to render full assistance. The Legate's command is suspended pending senatorial review.

In nomine Senatus Populique Romani
gm_notes:
WHEN: Session 2, when Tribune Lucius produces credentials or the party investigates his authority.
HOW: Heavy parchment, bold heading, wide margins. Add a wax seal impression.
WHAT IT REVEALS: This document is real and legally binding. The Tribune has legitimate Senate authority that supersedes the Legate's command. The party faces a genuine conflict between their direct superior and the Senate. Do not have Corvinus dismiss it — he cannot. His only options are compliance or a crime.
